fields.label: runZero console host
fields.description: Console host only, e.g. console.runzero.com for the SaaS platform, or your self-hosted console's FQDN -- no scheme or path (Crogl adds https:// and /api/v1.0).

fields.label: Export token (ET)
fields.description: runZero Export Token (starts with ET), created under Organizations -> [org] -> Edit organization -> Export tokens. Read-only; scoped to the /api/v1.0/export path for this one organization. Injected server-side as the Authorization: Bearer header.

fields.label: Skip TLS verification
fields.description: Skip TLS certificate verification (for self-hosted consoles presenting a self-signed or internal-CA certificate).
